questions.question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Hit a brick wall
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **"Encounter an obstacle"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's see the meaning of the word "**Hit a brick wall" **and other words given in the options.

 
 
• **Hit a brick wall **means unable to continue or make progress because of a hindrance.

 
 
• **Example:- **The discussions in Brussels hit a brick wall.
 
 
 
• **Use unfair tactics **means actions that are not fair and dishonest.
 
 
• **Example**:- Students are advised not to use unfair tactics to score better on the surprise test.
 
 
 
• **Go to sleep** means falling asleep
 
 
• **​Example:- **All children were requested to go to sleep before 10 pm.
 
 
 
• **Encounter an obstacle **means facing roadblocks or problems while doing any task.
 
 
• **Example**:- He encountered many obstacles in his field,
 
 
 
• **Hit someone with a brick **means to go out on strike.
 
 
• **Example:- **After the Government's decision to reduce MSP all the farmers are ready to hit with a brick.
 
 
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct answer is Option no 3 i.e. **Encounter an obstacle****.**

questions.question:
**Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.**

A. However, physical fitness and a stubborn fearlessness never let a climber fail.

B. The equipment can be made so light that no extra energy is spent in carrying it.

C. To a large extent, the physical difficulties can be reduced by paying attention to the equipment.

D. It is certain that weather plays an important part in the success or failure of mountain climbers.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is:** DCBA**.

 
• The paragraph tells us that there is little doubt that the weather has a significant impact on mountain climbers' success or failure (D). Paying close attention to the equipment can greatly decrease the physical challenges (C). It is possible to make the equipment so light that carrying it requires no additional energy (B). However, a climber's physical preparedness and unyielding lack of fear ensure success (A).
 
• As we can see, it is the perfect chronological order of the sentence.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is: **DCBA**.

questions.question:
The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don’t find any error, mark ‘No error’ as your answer.

If you want scoring well / in the examination, / your answers must be to the point.

options.text: your answers must be to the point

questions.solution:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the first part of the sentence "**If you want scoring well"**

 
 
• **​**In this part of the sentence the word "**IF"** is showing condition
 
• The use of want is correct according to the subject "**You".****​**
 
• Here "**Want"** is working as a **Main verb.**
 
• There are some verbs in English that are followed by "**To + Main Verb" **
 
 
• **​Example:- **
 
 
• **​**I want to **becoming** a doctor **(Wrong)**.
 
• I want **to become** a doctor **(Correct)**
 
 
 
 
 
• **​**Hence, according to this concept, the error lies in part A of the sentence i.e. option no 4.
 
 
 
• The correct sentence is *"If you want** to score** well in the examination, your answers must be to the point." *

questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct speech.

The teacher asked if everyone was present in the class that day.

options.text: The teacher said, "Is everyone present in the class today?"
The teacher said, "Was everyone present in the class that day?"
The teacher said, "Was everyone present in the class today?"
The teacher said, "Is everyone present in the class that day?"

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **"The teacher said, "Is everyone present in the class today?"".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's see the type of sentence and its direct speech given in the sentence.
 
 
• Here, The reporting verb is "**asked". **
 
• **"Asked" **is the reporting verb and it is used when we convert **"Verbal questions into Indirect Speech".**
 
• **"IF" **is working as conjunction. It simply means that this Indirect speech of **Verbal Question**
 
• In this part of the sentence **"if everyone was present in the class that day." was is used**
 
• "**Is"(Direct Speech) **must be converted into "**was"(Indirect speech)**
 
• We need to find the option in which **"is" **is used.
 
• The option no 1 is the correct answer.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9074044cf96dc1d09ca89eac99180c3d7440ade1b364d09d47931959bf693cc8.png] **Confusion Points__**

 
• We may get confused between option no 1 and Option no 4
 
 
• Both may sound same
 
• But there is a small difference between "that day"
 
• In option no 1 word "**Today" is used at the ending.**
 
• **However, **In option no 4 word "**That day " at the ending.**
 
• **Hence, That day is used in indirect speech we need a sentence of Direct speech in which Today is used**
 
• **In option no 1 Today is used**
 
• **In option no 4 that day is used (wrong answer)**
 
 

** ****​So the correct answer is** *"**The teacher said, "Is everyone present in the class today?"*

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Pertinent
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **"Relevant"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's see the meaning of the word "**Pertinent" **and other words given in the options.

 
 
• **Pertinent (Adj) **means relevant or applicable to a particular matter.

 
 
• **Example:- **She asked me a lot of very pertinent questions.
 
 
 
• **Relevant (Adj) **means closely connected or appropriate to what is being done or considered
 
 
• **Example:- **The example was given by Rajesh was correct by it not relevant to the question.
 
 
 
• **Unrelated (Adj) **means not related or linked
 
 
• **Example:- **He always asks unrelated questions.
 
 
 
• **Puzzling (Adj) means **causing one to puzzle, to be in a confusing position or stage.
 
 
• **Example:- **Priya has been facing a puzzling situation as She has to choose between her own career or her Family.
 
 
 
• **Living (**verb gerund or present participle: living) means **To live.**
 
 
• **​Example:- **He **lives** in New Delhi. (**Live as Main Verb).**
 
 
 
 
 
• Hence, according to the meaning of the words the correct answer is *"**Relevant".***

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

His painting was declared the best ______ all the entries.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 2.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's see the use of prepositions mentioned in the options.
 
 
• **Between:- **​Between is often used to refer to the time, space, or differences that separate two things, people, places, ideas, etc.

 
 
• **Example:- **The first prize was distributed between Dhruv and Kavya.
 
 
 
• **Among:- **​Among is used when talking about people or things that are not distinct and are viewed as a group
 
 
• **Example:- **Students distributed notes among the students.
 
 
 
• **From:- **We use from to refer to the place where someone or something starts or originates
 
 
• **Example:- **I am walking from my college.
 
 
 
• **Through:- **from one end or side of something to the other
 
 
• **Example:- **They walked slowly through the woods
 
 
 
• The complete sentence will be "His painting was declared the best **among **all the entries"
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct answer is option 2.

questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in reported speech.

Vandana said to me, "I don't want to buy the same dress as yours."

options.text: Vandana told me that I don't want to buy the same dress as yours.
Vandana told me that I didn't want to buy the same dress as hers.
Vandana told me that she didn't want to buy the same dress as mine.
Vandana told me that she doesn't want to buy the same dress as mine.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is** "Vandana told me that she didn't want to buy the same dress as mine."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's see the grammatical structure of the given direct speech sentence and the answers given in the options.
 
 
• **Here Vandana **is talking so "**Vandana" **is the reporter.
 
• "**Said to " **is the reporting verb.
 
• "**me" **is the listener.
 
• "**I don't want to buy the same dress as yours" **is the reported speech narrated by "**Vandana".**
 
• Hence, The type of sentence of the reported speech is "**Assertive Sentence" So we have to apply the rules of Assertive Sentences.**
 
• "**Said to will be converted into told.**
 
• **"That" **Conjunction is used When Assertive Sentence is converted into Indirect Speech.
 
• In the Reported Speech "I" refers to Vandana. Vandana is a third-person Singular So It will be converted into She.
 
• **Present tense (Negative) **is converted into **Past Tense (Negative).**
 
• "**Me" **(is the objective case). "**Yours"** is the **possessive Pronoun** case.
 
• So, "**Yours" **is used for me and the **Possessive Pronoun case for Me is "Mine".**
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct answer is option no 3.

questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

India is celebrating the 75th Azadi ka Amrit Mahotsava this year.

options.text: The 75th Azadi ka Amrit Mahotsava has been celebrated by India this year.
The 75th Azadi ka Amrit Mahotsava was celebrated by India this year.
This year India is being celebrated by the 75th Azadi ka Amrit Mahotsava.
The 75th Azadi ka Amrit Mahotsava is being celebrated by India this year.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is** "The 75th Azadi ka Amrit Mahotsava is being celebrated by India this year."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The tense of given sentence is "**Present Continuous"**

 
 
• **​Active Voice (Present continuous) **Subject + am/is/are/ + Mainverb (ing form) + object 
 
• **Passive Voice (Present Continuous) **Object + am /is/are+ being + main verb (3rd form) + by + Subject.
 
• **"India"** is the Subject of the Sentence.
 
• **Celebrate** is the Main verb
 
• the 75th Azadi ka Amrit Mahotsava this year is the object.
 
• So according to the structure of the passive voice the correct answer is option no 4.
